title: Neural network links pyrene transformation products to soil microbes
summary: MMvec established co-occurrence links between pyrene transformation products and soil microbes and outperformed Pearson and Spearman correlation. Findings were supported by metagenomics, isolation of degraders and DNA-SIP direct evidence. The study concerns a single contaminant.
